title: MashAuraSystem
description: Aura currency system with GUI shop, leaderboard and aura consumable items.
body:
Players cannot gain Aura naturally. Aura is controlled by staff through commands and aura items.

## Core Features

- Admin-managed Aura balances (`add`, `remove`, `set`)
- GUI-based Aura shop with categories and confirmation
- Hidden Aura mode with toggle support
- Right-click player Aura view with cooldown/bypass
- Leaderboard with hidden-value display support
- Anti-dupe protections for GUI purchases
- Aura consumable items from `aura-items.yml`
- PlaceholderAPI support

## Commands

### Player

- `/aura`
- `/aura shop`
- `/aura top <page>`
- `/aura toggle`

### Admin

- `/aura admin add <player> <amount>`
- `/aura admin remove <player> <amount>`
- `/aura admin set <player> <amount>`
- `/aura admin toggle <player>`
- `/aura admin shop`
- `/aura admin auraitem give <player> <id> [amount]`
- `/aura admin reload`

## Permissions

- `mashaura.use`
- `mashaura.shop`
- `mashaura.top`
- `mashaura.toggle`
- `mashaura.view`
- `mashaura.view.bypasscooldown`
- `mashaura.admin`
- `mashaura.admin.add`
- `mashaura.admin.remove`
- `mashaura.admin.set`
- `mashaura.admin.shop`
- `mashaura.admin.toggle`

## Placeholders

- `%mashaura_value%`
- `%mashaura_color%`
- `%mashaura_colored_value%`
- `%mashaura_rank%`
